buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Bid specific Scope of Work (SoW) & Additional Terms & Con ditions (ATC) The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), Kolkata, invites tenders from eligible and ex perienced agencies/firms for the Supply and Installation of Passive Network Co mponents at the Ground and First Floors of the New Academic Building (C. R. Ra o Bhavan), C. R. Rao Bhavan, ISI, Kolkata. The work shall be executed as per th e List of Items in Annexure–I and the Technical Specifications in Annexure–II, inc luding supply, installation, associated civil works, testing, commissioning and h anding over of the complete passive network infrastructure. The scope of work shall include, but not be limited to, the following: 1. Supply of all specified passive network components, accessories a nd consumables as per Annexure–I and Annexure–II. 2. Installation of structured network cabling, racks, patch panels, data outlets, cable managers and associated accessories. 3. Laying of OFC cables through suitable and properly installed conduits, including all associated civil works such as chasing, drilling, cutting, fixing, s ealing and restoration, wherever required. 4. Proper cable routing, dressing, termination, tagging and labelling of all netw ork points. 5. Testing and certification of installed network links using suitable testing equ

ipment. 6. Rectification/replacement of defective materials or workmanship during test ing and commissioning. 7. Submission of test reports, cable schedules/as-built documentation and oth er required records. 8. Coordination with the Institute and other agencies at site during execution. 9. Cleaning of the work area and complete handing over of the installed syste m in working condition. 10. Provision of all minor accessories, hardware and incidental works necessary for complete execution of the installation. 11. One year On Site Warranty on all installed components need to be provided by Bidder. Bidder/OEM Eligibility Criteria : 1. OEM of all passive components offered must be registered and operating in India for more than at-least 10 years. 2. OEM shall have at-least one RCDD certified technical staff based in India. 3. OEM must have experience of manufacturing the offered products in India f or min. 10 years. ISO certificate for manufacturing experience should be sub mitted with technical bid. 4. The CAT6A SCS must be tested under 4 connector channel configuration by any accredited 3rd Party test facility to the following standards and the same should be submitted along with the technical bid: 4.1. ANSI/TIA 568-C.2: Category 6A Channel – 100m long channel & 15m sho rt channel. 4.2. IEEE 802.3bt (Type 4) 4PPoE transmission under 4 connector channel up to temperature of +60 Deg C. 4.3. 3rd Party verification test reports should be submitted with the RFP. 5. OEM shall have min 5 design and manufacturing facilities spread across Indi a or global locations duly certified under ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 standar ds. 6. Bidder must be a registered company in India and should have a full-fledge d registered service location in Kolkata and agglomeration districts. Supporti ng documentary evidence must be submitted. 7. The bidder must have a previous experience in supply and installation of at- least two similar passive networking components in Government Institutions/ Autonomous Bodies/Public Sector Undertaking, through a single order for not less than the estimated bid value, during the last 3 financial years. Supportin g valid documents (Completion certificate) for such projects completed not la ter than the Bid Publication date must be submitted. 8. The bidder must have valid ISO 9001 certificate as on the last date for bid s

ubmission. Supporting valid documents must be submitted for evaluation. 9. Bidder should carefully go through the Scope of Work & Annexure- I & II. Fo r any confusion, they should get it cleared during pre- bid meeting. 10. Bidder should submit Annexure-III (Make in India Certificate) & Annexure –IV (Undertaking) on their letterhead with proper seal & signature , otherwis e bid will rejected in Technical Evaluation. 11. The Bidder should upload at least one contract orders having 50% of the Estimated bid value (i.e. 50% of Rs. 12,00,000/-) in a single contra ct during any of the last three financial years (FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 onwards) in any Government/Govt. autonomous/ Public Sector Undertakings/ Multi National Company. 12. Bidder seeking MSME exemption and or Preference, should have MSME certi ficate on justified category. 13. Bidder have to submit the original EMD within 3 working days from the bid e nd date. 14. Bidder have to submit the original Security deposit in form of ePBG within 7 working days from the placement of Work Order. 15. Multiple bids received from the same IP ADDRESS will be cancelled. The OFC shall be laid through minimum 19mm PVC conduit within the building premises in the Ins titute’s campus including scaffolding or any other incidental work as per requirement at site. The b idder shall visit the site to assess the condition. 2. Outside the building, the cable shall be laid through BIS-certified HDPE conduit of minimum 19mm diameter in a trench of 1.0 metre depth and 0.3 metre width. At road crossings, BIS-marked GI me dium pipe of minimum 19mm diameter shall be used, as per site requirements. 3. The bidder shall be responsible for excavation of trenches through all types of soil, concrete and b ituminous surfaces, as well as for the complete restoration of the damaged roads, pathways, concr ete pavements or any other service lines e.g. plumbing, electrical, network cables etc. and backfilli ng with proper compaction of excavated trenches to the satisfaction of the User Department upon completion of the work. 4. The bidder shall also ensure proper marking and identification of the OFC route/path during execu tion of the work. The marking shall be completed prior to handing over the installation. Details of Civil works related to cable laying: 1. Indoor Cable Laying (Within Building Premises) 1.1. Conduit Installation: Lay the OFC through heavy-duty PVC conduits s ubject to prior approval from the User Department.

1.2. Site Preparation: Include all necessary scaffolding, drilling, staging, an d incidental structural works required to secure the conduits. 1.3. Site Assessment: The bidder must conduct a mandatory site visit prior to bidding to assess exact field conditions and routing challenges. 2. Outdoor Cable Laying & Trenching 2.1. Standard Trenching: Excavate trenches outside buildings to a standar d depth of 1.0 metre (or a minimum of 0.60 metres in hard rock/restricte d areas upon approval) and a width of 0.30 metres. 2.2. Conduit Protection: Route the outdoor cable through Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certified High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) ducts. 2.3. Road Crossings: Protect the cable at all road, pathway, and drain cros sings by encasing the OFC inside a BIS-marked Galvanized Iron (GI) medi um-class pipe. 3. Excavation, Right-of-Way, and Restoration 3.1. Excavation Scope: Execute trenching through all strata, including soft soil, hard soil, concrete pavements, and bituminous roads. 3.2. Utility Protection: Safeguard all existing underground utilities, includi ng water pipelines, electrical lines, and existing communication networks. The bidder bears sole liability for any accidental damages. 3.3. Civil Restoration: Reclaim, backfill, and compact the excavated trenc hes using proper mechanical ramming. Restore damaged roads, pathway s, and concrete surfaces to their original finish and to the complete satisf action of the User Department. 4. Route Marking and Documentation 4.1. Route Markers: Install permanent, high-visibility concrete or electronic OFC route markers and joint indicators along the outdoor path at regular intervals (every 50-100 metres) and at every turning point. 4.2. Indoor Labelling: Provide clear, indelible identification tags and labels on PVC conduits at entry, exit, and junction boxes. 4.3. Handover Requirement: Complete all routing markers, line testing, a nd submit "As-Built" drawings prior to the final handover of the installatio n.
